text:
julian: Heads up — FS customer wants a POC but their security questionnaire requires ALL inference traffic and logs to stay within EU boundaries (including control-plane telemetry). They asked for a concrete configuration + pricing delta.

priya: do we have a canned FAQ for "control plane in EU"? I remember we only guarantee data plane in hosted.

evan: correct. Hosted: inference + storage can be EU-region pinned. Control plane (accounting/telemetry) is centralized in us-east by default. For contractually binding EU control plane we offer Private or an EU control-plane option for large deals.

sam: they also want the subprocessor list for EU-only compute and confirmation that monitoring/alerting won't phone home to US.

julian: legal will want the redacted subproc list; ops will need to confirm monitoring.

natalie-legal: we can provide DPA + subproc manifest. Note: some third-party alerting integrations (pager, incident analytics) are US-based unless we run them on-customer infra. We can add a contractual annex to restrict those, but that usually moves the deal to enterprise terms.

priya: BYOK + HSM? customer requires keys to be generated and stored in EU HSM only.

evan: BYOK with EU HSM is supported in Private. For Dedicated we can integrate with customer-managed KMS in their VPC; HSM-backed attestation is a professional-services item.

julian: they asked for a sample routing policy snippet to show engineers. Can someone paste something they can include in their questionnaire? Keep it simple.

sam: snippet — note we use YAML in infra requests:

```
tenant_policies:
  - tenant_id: fs-poc-001
    region_affinity: [eu-west-1, eu-west-2]
    failover_policy: none # disables cross-region fallback
    telemetry_scope: eu-only
    allowed_subprocessors: [aws-eu, gcp-eu]
    kms_mode: customer-managed-byo
```

priya: add comment that `failover_policy: none` will affect availability — ops needs to sign off.

natalie-legal: suggested contract language: "Provider shall not transmit, copy, or store customer inference inputs, outputs, or logs outside the European Economic Area except where required by mandatory applicable law." Ops/security will review.

evan: ops note: to guarantee that we need Dedicated with tenant isolation or Private with EU control plane. Hosted customers can be configured but cannot be contractually guaranteed without Private.

julian: pricing — rough delta? customer expects a line-item for EU-control-plane and BYOK-HSM.

sam: ballpark: Dedicated = hosted base * ~4 (depends on GPU ops) + BYOK/HSM/attestation add ~12% and one-off integration ~5k-10k. Private (EU control plane) includes one-time deployment ~8k plus monthly infra premium. I'll flag finance.

priya: I'll prepare answers for the questionnaire: 1) include the YAML snippet, 2) attach redacted subproc list, 3) state BYOK/Private path and PS estimate, 4) caveat on SLA if failover disabled.

julian: thanks. tagging @ops-bot to open INF ticket to validate monitoring/alerting pathways and confirm which integrations are US-only.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-8021 created: "FS POC — validate telemetry and alerting pathways for EU-only deployment" assigned to evan, due 2024-12-01.

evan: picking this up, will run routing matrix and list alerting endpoints that need gating.

natalie-legal: I'll draft the DPA + redacted subproc list and share.

julian: great — i'll send the questionnaire responses tomorrow and request a follow-up call.

sam: happy to join call for architectural walkthrough.

julian: closing for now, will reopen if they push on control-plane deadlines.
